svg.text: One clip, one swing, filmed down the line.
Or drop a different clip anywhere on this card. mp4 or mov, up to 15 seconds.

text.tspan: Stored on the AIcoach server until you delete it. Leave this off and the clip is
deleted as soon as the analysis is done.

svg.text: Your clip is private to your account.

text.tspan: Stand behind your hands, phone pointing along the
target line. Face-on clips are rejected.

g.text: Prop it on your bag or a stand, not in someone’s hand.
About three to four steps back from your hands.
Whole body and club in frame
Feet, head and the clubhead at the top all visible.
Slow-motion mode. At 30 fps impact is a blur.
Trim the clip to a single swing, 15 seconds at most.

svg.text: Same page after “Analyse my swing”: the analysing state
Five passes, like five inks on the drum. Keep this page open.
Found your body in every frame.
Address 0.00 s, top 0.84 s, impact 1.21 s.
Measuring hip movement, posture angle and hand path.
Checks early extension, loss of posture and over the top.
Writes your result in plain language from the measurements.
The clip is deleted if you cancel.
